fields.issue: The wrinkling criterion sigma_wr = 0.5*(E_f*Ec*Gc)^(1/3) is the flat-panel/dimple formula transferred to a 10 m radius sandwich sphere. Orthotropic honeycomb has no single continuum Ec; the two HexWeb sheets carry no compressive modulus on their datasheets, so their Ec*Gc products stay open (007). Foam products (ROHACELL, Divinycell) are datasheet-derived and QUESTIONABLE.
fields.consequence: The wrinkling column measures a product gap, not a verified failure mode. MAINLINE-007b is sourced to replace this reading.
fields.next: 007b's sourced sandwich-shell shear and wrinkling formulas supersede this column when filed.
